_comment: Rack-aware cluster.json — extends cluster.json with a 'racks' block for switch tray targeting.
_user_comment: user-id will be resolved to current username in runtime. You can also change to your user-id here.
_key_comment: Change <priv_key_file> to your private key if it is different.
_env_vars_comment: Custom env variables to be exported before executing each command
_node_comment: Change to your node IPs. The Public IPs of the nodes will be the keys of the node_dict.
_vpc_comment: If your cluster has a dedicated VPC IP that is reachable from other nodes in the cluster, set it to that (or) else set the same as the main host IP/Name
_rack_id_comment: rack_id associates each compute node with a rack entry in the 'racks' block below. For ARC, list each rack's nodes in tray order (Helios: the compute in U9 first, U33 last); the position becomes the ARC tray_id.
_racks_comment: Rack block. cvs exec --target switches reads switch_trays and the switch_ssh_* login. ARC suites also read platform and the device lists to generate one ARC rack file per rack. Every device list is optional: omit it when that device is not reachable.

racks._bmc_comment: Optional. One BMC login used for every BMC listed in this file (compute bmc_ip, switch_bmc, rmc, power_shelves). Required with rmc or power_shelves. Omit when BMC access is not available.

rack-01._platform_comment: ARC platform name: HeliosP, HeliosR, or HeliosM. Required for ARC rack file generation.
rack-01._switch_model_comment: Optional. Scale-up switch model when the platform allows more than one. Needed only with switch_trays.
rack-01._arc_controller_comment: Optional. Host that runs ARC for this rack. Omit to use the first node_dict entry with this rack_id.
rack-01._switch_trays_comment: Optional. Scale-up switch host addresses in tray order (Helios: U19 first, U24 last). Omit when switch SSH is not available.
rack-01._switch_bmc_comment: Optional. Scale-up switch BMC addresses, same order and length as switch_trays. Omit when BMC access is not available.
rack-01._rmc_comment: Optional. Rack management controller addresses, in tray order (HeliosM has four RSCMs). Omit when the RMC is not reachable.
rack-01._front_end_switches_comment: Optional. Front-end switch host addresses, in tray order. Omit when you are not running front-end switch diagnostics.
rack-01._back_end_switches_comment: Optional. Back-end switch host addresses, in tray order. Omit when you are not running back-end switch diagnostics.
